subject: Finalize banking + PO mapping for AxiomEdge onboarding
messages:
From: Lena Morales <finance@axiomedge.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: vendor-payments@axiomedge.com
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 16:18:00 +0000
Subject: AxiomEdge banking details and PO remittance fields

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for the onboarding walkthrough yesterday. Per our checklist, attached are the banking artifacts you requested so we can receive the first payment and map PO references correctly. Quick notes: 

- Primary payment rail: ACH (NACHA) into AxiomEdge operating account.
- Wire fallback enabled (we included beneficiary wiring instructions).
- We need invoices to include the PO number in the "InvoiceRef" field and our internal ledger tag (AX-LE-##) in the remittance string so our AR system can auto-apply.

Attachments: AxiomEdge_bank_letter.pdf (bank letter confirming account), voided_check.jpg, axiomedge_remit_template.csv (sample CSV with InvoiceRef and LedgerTag columns).

Please let us know if Finance needs anything else before the test-run. We can approve micro-deposit verification if required.

Best,
Lena Morales
Finance Director | AxiomEdge Solutions
phone: +1 (415) 555-0198

--
Attachment stubs: AxiomEdge_bank_letter.pdf (PDF, 72KB); voided_check.jpg (JPEG, 120KB); axiomedge_remit_template.csv (CSV, 3KB)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Lena Morales <finance@axiomedge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AxiomEdge banking details and PO remittance fields

Hi Lena —

Thanks for the docs, appreciate the clean remit template. A couple quick follow-ups from Finance and Payments Ops so we can schedule the first settlement: 

1) Bank ownership proof: the attached bank letter is good but we need the letter to be signed and include the bank's ACH routing/country clearing identifiers explicitly on page 1. Can you confirm your bank can re-issue with the routing detail visible?

2) Remittance mapping: we can accept "InvoiceRef" + "LedgerTag" as columns. For automapping we require the InvoiceRef to match the PO exactly (including any prefix). Please confirm your PO format (example: PO-AX-3942).

3) Micro-deposit vs tokenized ACH: For production we prefer to enable tokenized ACH on our side after a successful micro-deposit test. Are you able to receive two micro-deposits in the test window (we initiate on 20 Jun if cleared)?

4) DocuSign: we still need the signed vendor agreement (we show the envelope outstanding HS-11234). If you can upload the signed PDF to the DocuSign link or attach here, that'll unblock monthly invoicing.

Marissa — can you take point on the account verification steps and confirm whether the voided check + bank letter meet Payments Ops standards once Lena responds?

Thanks —
Sofia
FinOps Manager | Redwood Inference

--
Note: internal request to Marissa and Ethan to validate ledger tagging and set up a one-off test payment.

From: Lena Morales <finance@axiomedge.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, vendor-payments@axiomedge.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 14:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: AxiomEdge banking details and PO remittance fields

Hi Sofia / Marissa —

Thanks for the clarity. Attached is an updated bank letter with the ACH routing visible on page 1 and a signed vendor agreement (signed by our CFO). We also confirmed our standard PO format is PO-AX-#### (four digits).

Answers inline: 
- Bank letter: updated and signed (AxiomEdge_bank_letter.pdf v2 attached).
- PO format: PO-AX-3942 (example) — we will ensure the InvoiceRef matches exactly.
- Micro-deposits: yes, we can accept two micro-deposits. Please schedule them for the week of 21 Jun; we will confirm receipt within 48 hours.

Attachments: AxiomEdge_bank_letter_signed.pdf (PDF, 78KB); signed_vendor_agreement.pdf (PDF, 64KB); axiomedge_remit_template.csv (CSV, 3KB)

If those look OK, can Redwood confirm the test initiation date and whether you'll create a one-time test payment so we can validate ledger auto-apply?

Thanks —
Lena Morales
Finance Director | AxiomEdge Solutions

--
Attachment stubs: AxiomEdge_bank_letter_signed.pdf (PDF, 78KB); signed_vendor_agreement.pdf (PDF, 64KB); axiomedge_remit_template.csv (CSV, 3KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lena Morales <finance@axiomedge.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AxiomEdge banking details and PO remittance fields

Hi Lena — Sofia —

All good from Payments Ops. Confirming next steps and timeline: 

1) We validated the signed bank letter and voided check — routing + ACH details present. 
2) We'll initiate two micro-deposits on Tue 2027-06-22 (expected posting 24–25 Jun depending on banks). Please reply to this thread when you see the micro-deposits so we can mark verification complete.

3) Once micro-deposits are verified, Marissa will toggle tokenized ACH for AxiomEdge and schedule the first live ACH for 2027-07-02. That run will reference PO as InvoiceRef — Redwood will include the PO in the remittance field exactly as provided (e.g., PO-AX-3942) and will append the ledger tag in the secondary remittance column (AX-LE-3942) for your AR auto-apply.

4) DocuSign: we received the signed vendor agreement (thank you). I'll upload the copy to the HubSpot record HS-11234 and to the vendor folder.

If anything changes on your side (different PO format or bank delays), please flag here. Otherwise we expect the verification flow to complete after you confirm the micro-deposits.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Payments Ops Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
